title: Halloween Weekend Brings Discounts on Apple Accessories and Pre-Orders
content:
It's Halloween weekend, and we're tracking a bunch of great accessory discounts from popular companies like Belkin, Hyper, and Anker. In addition to these seasonal sales, below you can find a recap of this week's top Apple offers, including pre-order discounts on Apple's new MacBooks and iPad mini, plus our exclusive Banktivity discount.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Halloween Deals




Tomorrow is Halloween, and in celebration of the holiday multiple retailers are hosting notable sales and discount events this weekend. These events include savings on MagSafe-compatible chargers, iPhone cases, noise cancelling headphones, and more.

  • Anker - Save an additional 20% sitewide with code HALLOWEEN20

  • Best Buy - Save sitewide on video games, iPads, and more

  • Belkin - Buy one, get one 30% off

  • GRID Studio - Up to 57% off select frames

  • Hyper - Save 25% on select products

  • Sony - Save on TVs, headphones, and more

  • ZAGG - Save 20% when buying any two items

  • Burton Goods - Get 15% off your first order with code NEW15

MacRumors has partnered with the personal finance app Banktivity to offer our readers a 30 percent discount on their first year of the service, plus a 30-day free trial. This deal is available to new subscribers only, and you can find it on Banktivity's website, where it has been automatically applied with no coupon code needed.

Apple announced an array of new products this week, including the iPad mini 8, M6 iMac, M6 14-inch MacBook Pro, and PROLED XDR MacBook Pro. A few of these devices have pre-order bonuses at Best Buy in the form of gift cards, and right now these are the only offers we're tracking on any of Apple's newest devices.

Apple's M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and a 512GB SSD is still on sale for $2,299.00, down from $2,499.00. Regarding the Mac mini, you can get the 16GB RAM/256GB SSD Mac mini for $779.00, down from $899.00, and the 16GB RAM/512GB SSD model for $949.00, down from $1,099.00.

If you're on the hunt for more discounts, be sure to visit our Apple Deals roundup where we recap the best Apple-related bargains of the past week.
